text:
anya: Hey team, stuck on quickstart. fresh workspace, followed README, first curl returns 402 Payment Required.

devex-bot: Automated note: provisioning/billing check failed for workspace 'acme-staging'. See /billing for details.

anya: Curl I ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-v0","input":"hi"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error":"workspace_not_billed","message":"Please add billing details to your workspace to make API calls."}
```

sam: Do you have a billing card on the workspace? New orgs sometimes need the workspace owner to accept terms.

anya: I'm org owner and added a card, but UI shows "Pending validation" and the API still 402.

michael: For service accounts the account-invite -> billing linkage sometimes doesn't finish. Can you try `redwoodctl workspace attach-billing acme-staging --force`? That's the devops CLI shim.

anya: Tried that, CLI errors with `403 Forbidden: insufficient_perms` even though I'm owner.

liz: Hmm that sounds like the backend role-check race we saw last month. @sam can you repro? If so we should make the SDK surface a clearer message (right now SDK throws a generic PaymentError on 402).

sam: I'll repro and report. If I can hit it I'll open a GH issue in devex/sdk with labels dx:onboard and bug and add steps. Quick workaround: invite a second owner and have them accept billing in the console, then retries succeed.

anya: Workaround worked after adding co-owner and accepting billing. Would be great if SDK returned an actionable error string with a console link.

devex-bot: Follow-up: ticket DEVEX-1127 created: improve SDK error messages for billing gating and CLI perms check. Assigned to @sam.

anya: thanks all :tada:
